AxisSpec.description: Revolve axis: `"u"`/`"v"` (sketch plane axis through the origin) or a 2D line in the sketch plane.

BodySel.description: `"*"` in field `body` = the only body (error if the count ≠ 1); `"*"` in field `bodies` = all bodies.

CheckItem.description: One check with optional id/note. Note: serde does not support `flatten` + `deny_unknown_fields`, so unknown fields are ignored here.

oneOf.description: Order X, Y, Z.
Exact center of mass (mm) must be within `tol` of `expect` on every axis.
Moment of inertia about an axis through the center of mass, in g*mm^2. Uses the body's mechanical material density (see op `set_material`) unless `density_g_cm3` is given.

Maximum von Mises stress (MPa) of a study result must not exceed `max_mpa`. `study` is the id of a `study` op (`"*"` = the only study). Status is `error` until the study has been run (tool `simulate_static`) and again after the model or the setup changes.
Maximum displacement magnitude (mm) of a study result must not exceed `max_mm`.
Safety factor (yield strength / max von Mises stress) of a study result must be at least `min`.
First natural frequency (Hz) of a `frequency` study must be at least `min_hz`.
Critical load factor of a `buckling` study must be at least `min` (below 1 = buckles).
Highest temperature (deg C) of a `thermal` study must not exceed `max_c`.
Sheet metal: every bend's inner radius divided by the sheet thickness must be at least `min_ratio_to_t` (e.g. 1.0 for mild steel, more for hard alloys).
Sheet metal: the straight length of every flange must be at least `min` mm (tooling needs material to grip; a common rule is 4 x thickness).

Tolerance stack-up of a dimension chain: the total variation of the closing dimension must not exceed `max_total` (mm). `method` is `worst_case` (default, arithmetic sum) or `rss` (root-sum-square, statistical). No geometry is measured: the chain is given explicitly.

ConfigurationSpec.description: One design variant: parameter overrides, suppressed ops and material overrides on top of the base design. The base design itself is the reserved configuration `"Default"`.

material_overrides.description: Body name -> mechanical material used in this variant.

name.description: Unique name (1-48 chars: letters, digits, space, `_`, `-`, `.`); also the build output directory name.

params.description: Parameters overridden by this variant; all others keep their base value.

suppressed_ops.description: Ids of ops skipped in this variant (e.g. an optional hole pattern).

ConstraintSpec.description: Sketch constraint. Entities are referenced by name; points by `"<name>.start" | ".end" | ".center"`.

oneOf.description: CCW angle from direction `a` to direction `b`, degrees.
Exactly one of `center`/`corner` (bottom-left corner). Children: `name.bottom`, `name.right`, `name.top`, `name.left`.
CCW arc from `start_deg` to `end_deg`.
Arc through three points.
Regular polygon with `sides` (3..=64); children `name.0 … name.{n-1}`.
Obround slot between centers `from`–`to` with radius `r`; children `name.0 …`.
Chain of lines; children `name.0 …`.

Fixture.description: A support applied to one or more faces.

faces.description: Face selector (same grammar as modeling ops, e.g. "<X" or "all[kind=cylinder][r=5]").

id.description: Unique id of this fixture; reaction forces are reported per id.

kind.description: How the selected faces are held.

oneOf.description: All three displacement components are zero on the face.
Displacement along the face normal is zero; sliding in the face is free.
Symmetry plane: same constraint as `roller` (no displacement along the face normal). Use it on the cut face of a half or quarter model.

InertiaAxis.description: Axis through the center of mass: a global axis or a principal axis (sorted by moment).

Load.description: A load. `kind` selects the load type and its parameters, for example `{"id":"f1","faces":">Z","kind":"force","newton":[0,0,-100]}`.

oneOf.description: Total force vector in newtons, spread uniformly over the area of the selected faces.

newton.description: Total force [Fx, Fy, Fz] in N.

oneOf.description: Uniform pressure normal to the selected faces.

mpa.description: Pressure in MPa (N/mm^2). Positive pushes on the body (acts along the inward face normal); negative pulls.

oneOf.description: Torque about an axis, applied to the selected faces as tangential forces that grow linearly with the distance from the axis. It is applied as a pure couple (zero net force), so `axis_point` documents where the axis is but does not change the resulting load.

axis_dir.description: Axis direction (need not be normalised); right-hand rule.

axis_point.description: A point on the torque axis, mm.

oneOf.description: Gravity (or any uniform acceleration) acting on the whole body. Uses the body's material density. `faces` must be omitted.

dir.description: Direction the acceleration points to, e.g. [0,0,-1].

g.description: Acceleration magnitude in m/s^2 (9.81 for standard gravity).

oneOf.description: Bearing load on a cylindrical face: a total force distributed as a cosine-shaped pressure over the half of the cylinder that the load pushes against.

newton.description: Total force [Fx, Fy, Fz] in N; normally perpendicular to the cylinder axis.

oneOf.description: A force acting at a remote point, transferred to the selected faces as the statically equivalent force plus moment.

point.description: Point where the force acts, mm.

faces.description: Face selector the load acts on. Required for every kind except `gravity`, which acts on the whole body.

anyOf.description: Key of a built-in or per-file library material (case-insensitive).

MechMaterialSpec.description: Mechanical material: a library key string, or `{"custom": {...}}` with explicit properties.

MechPropsSpec.description: Isotropic material properties at room temperature.

thermal_expansion_per_k.description: Linear thermal expansion coefficient in 1/K; default 0.

yield_strength_mpa.description: Yield strength in MPa (> 0, at most `ultimate_strength_mpa`).

oneOf.description: Voxel hexahedral mesh (engineering estimate, about +/-10 %).

Conforming quadratic tetrahedral mesh (Tet10): follows curved faces and gives better stress near holes and fillets. Falls back to hex with warning `SIM_MESH_FALLBACK_HEX` when the body cannot be meshed.

MeshSettings.description: Mesh controls. With neither `cell_mm` nor `target_elems` the cell size starts at 1/40 of the largest bounding-box dimension and is adapted so the mesh has between 20,000 and 200,000 elements.

cell_mm.description: Explicit cell edge length in mm. Cells are stretched slightly per axis so the grid fits the bounding box exactly. Takes precedence over `target_elems`.

kind.description: Mesh type; only "hex" is supported for now.

target_elems.description: Approximate number of elements to aim for when `cell_mm` is omitted.

Op.description: One modeling step. Field `op` selects the kind; `id` is unique (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`) and becomes the name of the body/sketch this op CREATES. Ops that MODIFY a body (fillet, chamfer, shell, hole, transform, pattern merge, draft, scale) keep the existing body name. Numbers may be param expressions: `"$w/2 - 3"`. Units: mm and degrees.

oneOf.description: 2D sketch on a plane: named entities + constraints. Creates no body; extrude/revolve/loft/sweep use it by `id`. Entity coordinates are the plane's local (u, v) (XY: u=X, v=Y; XZ: u=X, v=Z; YZ: u=Y, v=Z).

constraints.description: Constraints between named entities (optional; the initial geometry already defines the shape).

oneOf.description: Extrude closed sketch regions along the plane normal. `mode` `new` creates body `id`; `add`/`cut` unions with / cuts body `target` (its name is kept). Holes inside a region are carried along.

material.description: `"default"`, `"from_style"` (fill color of path entities), or a preset name.

outline.description: Extrude only the outline (stroke) with width `width`, not the fill.

per_object.description: One body per selected entity (`id.<name>`), `new` mode only; for vectors/logos.

profile.description: Regions to extrude: `"all"` (default), `{"names":["outline"]}`, or `{"at":[u,v]}` (smallest region containing the point).

sketch.description: Id of the source sketch op.

target.description: Body name for `add`/`cut` mode; must be empty for `new`.

oneOf.description: Revolve sketch regions around an axis in the sketch plane. The profile must not cross the axis.

axis.description: `"u"`/`"v"` (plane axis through the sketch origin) or `{"origin":[u,v],"dir":[du,dv]}`.

sketch.description: Id of the source sketch op.

oneOf.description: Primitive body named `id`. Box: minimum corner at `at` (or centered on `at` when `centered`). Cylinder/cone: base center at `at`, growing toward +Z. Sphere: center at `at`.
Boolean of two bodies → new body named `id`. Bodies `a` and `b` are CONSUMED (referencing them again → `body_consumed`); use `id` in later ops.

a.description: First body (for `subtract`: the one being cut).

oneOf.description: Round body edges (body modified in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

edges.description: Edge selector, e.g. `"|Z"` (vertical edges) or `"of(>Z)"` (top face perimeter).

radius_end.description: Variable fillet: radius at the end of each edge (start = `radius`).

oneOf.description: Equal-distance chamfer on body edges (body modified in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Hollow the body into a shell of `thickness`, opening faces `remove_faces` (body modified in place; walls grow inward). Any face can be opened, so the cavity can face any direction.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

depth.description: Cavity depth in mm, measured from the opened face into the body. Omitted or `0` = full cavity (down to a floor of `thickness`). `> 0` leaves the material below that depth solid; it needs exactly 1 planar opened face and must be < body height − `thickness` (else `shell_depth_too_deep` + `fixes`).

remove_faces.description: Selector of the faces to remove: `">Z"` opens the top, `"<Z"` the bottom, `">X"`, `"<X"`, `">Y"`, `"<Y"` a side; several faces open several sides.

thickness.description: Wall thickness (> 0, < half the smallest body dimension).

oneOf.description: Standard/custom hole perpendicular to a planar face, going into the material (body modified in place). Give `at` and/or `at_world`.

at.description: Local (u, v) points on the face plane: origin = face centroid, u = world +X projected onto the face (+Y if the face is perpendicular to X), v = normal × u. Face `>Z`: u = X, v = Y.

at_world.description: World points, projected perpendicular onto the face plane.

body.description: Name of the body to drill.

face.description: Selector that must match exactly 1 planar face, e.g. `">Z"`.

oneOf.description: Pattern copies of a body. `merge: false` (default): new copies `id.1`, `id.2`, …; `merge: true`: all copies are unioned into `body`.

body.description: Name of the source body.

merge.description: Union the copies into the source body.

oneOf.description: Move and/or rotate a body (modified in place); translate first, then rotate.

body.description: Name of the body to move.

oneOf.description: Delete a body from the model (e.g. a helper body or cutting tool).

body.description: Name of the body to delete.

oneOf.description: Loft a solid through ≥ 2 ordered sketches (one closed region per sketch; any plane, e.g. `{"base":"XY","offset":30}`).

sections.description: Section sketch ids, ordered from start to end (≥ 2).

oneOf.description: Sweep a sketch profile along a path (open sketch or 3D points).

path.description: Id of a sketch holding an open chain, or `{"points":[[x,y,z],…]}`.

sketch.description: Id of the section sketch (closed region), ideally perpendicular to the start of the path.

oneOf.description: Spring / thread: a section swept along a helix. External/internal thread = `mode: "add"`/`"cut"` on a shaft/hole.

end_r.description: Radius at the top end (conical helix).

oneOf.description: Mold draft on planar faces.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

faces.description: Selector of the faces to draft, e.g. `"#Z"` (side walls).

neutral.description: Selector of 1 planar face = neutral plane (does not move).

oneOf.description: Mirror a body across a plane. `copy` (default): new body named `id`; `merge`: the original body is replaced by its union with the mirror image.

body.description: Name of the source body.

merge.description: Union the mirror image into the original body (keeps the name `body`).

oneOf.description: Uniform scale about `pivot`.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

pivot.description: Fixed point of the scale; default origin.

oneOf.description: Cut a body with a plane. `keep: "both"` (default): the original body keeps the side along `normal`, new body `id` keeps the other side.

body.description: Name of the body to cut.

point.description: Point on the cutting plane; default origin.

oneOf.description: Assign a mechanical material (density, Young's modulus, Poisson ratio, yield strength) to a body. Drives `mass_g`, the inertia tensor, the `mass`/`moment_of_inertia` checks and simulation studies. Does not change the body's appearance or geometry.

body.description: Name of the body to assign the material to.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: create the base plate of a folded part from a sketch whose closed region is a straight-sided polygon. The body remembers thickness, bend radius and k-factor for later `edge_flange` / `hem` / `jog` / `unfold` / `flat_pattern` ops.

bend_radius.description: Default inner bend radius in mm; default = thickness.

k_factor.description: Neutral-axis k-factor (0..1) used for bend allowance BA = angle * (R + k*t); default 0.44.

sketch.description: Id of the sketch holding exactly one closed polygon (line segments only).

thickness.description: Sheet thickness in mm (> 0); the plate grows along the sketch plane normal.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: bend a flange up from one or more free straight edges of the base flange. The flange spans the full edge. Flanges on flanges are not supported yet.

angle.description: Bend angle in degrees (default 90). Positive bends toward the sketch normal, negative away from it; magnitude in (0, 180].

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

edges.description: Edge selector resolving to outer straight edges of the base plate (top or bottom rim).

length.description: Straight length of the flange after the bend, in mm.

radius.description: Inner bend radius; default = the body's default bend radius.

relief.description: Bend relief shape recorded for manufacturing notes: `none` (default), `rect`, `obround`. Not yet cut into the geometry.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: fold an edge back on itself by 180 degrees (a hem).

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

gap.description: Gap between the lip and the plate in mm (inner bend radius = gap / 2); default = thickness (an open hem).

length.description: Length of the returned lip in mm.

up.description: `true` folds toward the sketch normal (default), `false` away from it.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: two opposite bends that offset the edge strip to a parallel plane (a jog).

angle.description: Bend angle of both bends in degrees (default 90), in (0, 90].

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

length.description: Length of the flat strip after the jog, in mm.

offset.description: Offset between the plate and the jogged strip in mm; positive = toward the sketch normal.

radius.description: Inner bend radius; default = the body's default bend radius.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: replace the folded body by its flat blank (bend allowance applied). Undo with `fold`.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: fold an unfolded body back into its bent shape.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body that was unfolded.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: create a new body `id` holding the flat blank of `body` (the folded body is kept). The outcome `detail` lists the bend lines; export the blank with `ducad-cli build --formats flat`.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body.

oneOf.description: Insert a standard part from the toolbox as a new body `id`: axis along +Z, seating plane at `at` (screws: underside of the head, shank toward -Z; nuts, washers, bearings and pins: bottom face). Threads are cosmetic (plain shank). The BOM lists the standard designation.

at.description: Position of the seating point [x,y,z]; default origin. Rotate with op `transform`.

length.description: Nominal length in mm; required for screws and pins, not allowed otherwise.

standard.description: `iso4762` (socket head cap screw), `iso4014` (hex bolt), `iso4032` (hex nut), `iso7089` (plain washer), `iso2338` (parallel pin), `bearing` (deep groove ball bearing).

oneOf.description: Thread on an external cylindrical face (ISO metric 60 degree profile). `cosmetic: true` (default) only records the thread for notes; `cosmetic: false` cuts the helical groove into the body (slow: about a second per ten turns).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

cosmetic.description: `true` (default): record only. `false`: cut real thread geometry.

face.description: Face selector resolving to exactly one cylindrical face (the shank).

from_end.description: Start from the other end of the cylinder.

length.description: Threaded length in mm measured from the start end; default = whole cylinder.

pitch.description: Thread pitch in mm; default = ISO coarse pitch for the cylinder diameter (M2-M12).

oneOf.description: Store a simulation study (fixtures, loads, mesh settings) in the design. Creates no body and does not run the solver: run it with tool `simulate_static` (or `ducad-cli sim`), then assert on the result with checks `max_stress`, `max_displacement`, `min_safety_factor` (kinds `static`, `thermal_stress`), `min_natural_frequency` (`frequency`), `min_buckling_factor` (`buckling`) or `max_temperature` (`thermal`). The body needs a mechanical material (op `set_material`) before the study can run.

modes.description: Number of modes for kinds `frequency` (default 10) and `buckling` (default 3); 1..=40.

setup.description: Body, fixtures, loads and mesh settings. `frequency` ignores loads; `thermal` uses only `body` and `mesh` (fixtures and loads may be empty lists).

thermal.description: Thermal boundary conditions; required for kinds `thermal` and `thermal_stress`.

OutlineSpec.description: Outline spec to extrude only the stroke line (not the fill).

PlaneSpec.description: Sketch plane: a name (`"XY"`/`"XZ"`/`"YZ"`, aliases `"top"`/`"front"`/`"right"`, case-insensitive), an offset named plane, or a planar face of a body.

ProfileSel.description: Profile selection: `"all"`, `{"names": [...]}` (sketch entity names), or `{"at": [u, v]}` (smallest region containing the point).

SegSpec.description: Segment of a `SubpathSpec` (straight line or cubic Bézier curve).

SimSetup.description: Linear static study setup: which body to analyse, how it is held (fixtures) and what acts on it (loads). Units: mm, N, MPa, m/s^2.

body.description: Name of the body to analyse (the id of the op that created it).

fixtures.description: Supports. At least one is required; together they must block all six rigid-body motions, otherwise the run fails with SIM_UNDERCONSTRAINED.

loads.description: Loads applied to the body. All loads act together in one load case.

mesh.description: Mesh controls. Omit to let the solver pick a cell size automatically.

StackLink.description: One link of a tolerance chain. Give either `plus`/`minus` (amounts above/below nominal, both normally >= 0) or an ISO 286 `fit` class such as `"H7"` or `"g6"`. `reverse: true` for a link that runs against the chain direction (its nominal is subtracted).

fit.description: ISO 286 tolerance class (holes: D E F G H JS K M N P; shafts: d e f g h js k m n p r s).

oneOf.description: Linear static stress analysis.
Natural frequencies (Hz) of the body held by the fixtures; loads are ignored.
Linear buckling: load factors that multiply the applied loads at the onset of buckling.
Steady-state heat conduction: temperature field from the `thermal` boundary conditions.
Steady-state conduction followed by a static study loaded by thermal expansion (plus any mechanical loads); the stress-free reference temperature is 20 degrees Celsius.

SubpathSpec.description: Closed or open chain of curves for `EntitySpec::Path`.

SweepPath.description: Sweep path: id of a sketch holding an open chain (lines/arcs/splines), or `{"points": [[x,y,z], ...]}` 3D polyline.

ThermalBc.description: A thermal boundary condition on one or more faces, for example `{"id":"hot","faces":"<X","kind":"temperature","celsius":120}`.

oneOf.description: Fixed temperature on the faces.
Prescribed heat flux through the faces.

w_per_mm2.description: Heat flux in W/mm^2. Positive heats the body (flows into it).

oneOf.description: Convection to a fluid at ambient temperature.

ambient_c.description: Ambient fluid temperature in degrees Celsius.

h_w_mm2k.description: Film coefficient in W/(mm^2*K). 1 W/(m^2*K) = 1e-6 W/(mm^2*K).

faces.description: Face selector (same grammar as modeling ops).

id.description: Unique id of this boundary condition.

ThermalSetup.description: Steady-state thermal study setup: boundary conditions on faces. Faces without a boundary condition are insulated. At least one `temperature` or `convection` boundary is required. Units: degrees Celsius, W, mm.

active_configuration.description: Variant to activate after loading; default is the base design (`"Default"`).

checks.description: Optional design checks (P7 format); `ducad-cli run` installs them into `design.checks` before running the ops.

configurations.description: Optional design variants; `ducad-cli build --all-configs` builds every one of them.
